brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 in cell 2,-1, run-2 in 1,-1, run-3 in 1,0, run-4 in 0,0 - one irrigation run in each base per find_sockets offers after bins limited to third-depth bin compatibility

finish.summary: 4-cell cluster built with irrigation runs in all four bases and third-depth planter bins compatible with pipe-through-cell. Build verified meshClash clear.

notes: 4 runs IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
